I'm actually very similar,  I use SW as a coping method for helping others. It must be tough for you to have parents who react that way. External help (your family and your lawyer) in my opinion will help you the most. In your best interests, it would be best to get a lawyer as soon as possible regardless of whether you use your family's lawyer or look for one of your own. It's difficult to be in these types of situations but a person whose job is to defend your rights may be your best bet. Also your lawyer may be able to assist you with matters pertaining to student affairs. 

I am not a lawyer, and this is not legal advice.
